task.title: Sign In to NoteForge
task.shortdesc: Sign in to your NoteForge account to access your notes on this device.

context.p: You need a NoteForge account to use the app. If you do not have one, tap Create Account on the sign-in screen.

step.cmd: Open the NoteForge app on your device.
Enter your email address and password on the sign-in screen.

taskbody.result: Your notes library loads and your content is available on this device.
